```{r load-packages, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(shiny)

library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(broom)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(forcats)
library(colorspace)
library(visdat)
library(naniar)
library(ggrepel)
library(styler)
library(lintr)
library(tidycensus)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(terra)
library(ncdf4)

river_coords <- read_csv("~/FishyG/data/survey_sites_vancouver_isl.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

tasmax <- rast("~/FishyG/data/Global_weather/PNWNamet_tasmax.nc.nc")

tmax <- rast("~/FishyG/data/Global_weather/t_max_monthly_1960_2025.nc", subds = "t_max")

pr <- rast("~/FishyG/data/Global_weather/monthly_prcp_1960_2025.nc", subds = "pr")

```

```{r}
river_coords <- river_coords %>%
  mutate(model = case_when(
    stream_name_pse %in% c("NANAIMO RIVER", "COWICHAN RIVER", "LITTLE QUALICUM RIVER", "CHEMAINUS RIVER") ~ "Model", TRUE ~"No model"
  ))

pal <- colorFactor("Dark2", domain = river_coords$model)
```

```{r}
tm_pr <- time(pr)

pr_years  <- as.integer(format(tm_pr, "%Y"))
pr_months <- as.integer(format(tm_pr, "%m"))

pal_p <- colorQuantile("Blues", values(pr), n = 7, na.color = "transparent")
```

```{r}
pal_t <- colorBin("RdYlBu", domain = values(tmax), bins = 8,
                  na.color = "transparent", reverse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  leafletOutput("map", height = 600),
  absolutePanel(
    bottom = 120, left = 30, width = 250,
    draggable = TRUE,
    style = "background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding: 12px;
             border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);",
    titlePanel("Site Map"),
    checkboxGroupInput("model", "Model:",
                         choices = sort(unique(river_coords$model)),
                         selected = unique(river_coords$model)),
    hr(),
  radioButtons("layer", "Climate layer:",
             choices = c("None" = "none",
                         "Mean precipitation" = "pr",
                         "Max temperature" = "tmax"),
             selected = "pr"),
    sliderInput("date", "Month:",
            min = min(tm_pr), max = max(tm_pr), value = max(tm_pr),
            timeFormat = "%b %Y",
            animate = animationOptions(interval = 400, loop = TRUE))
    )
  )


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  filtered <- reactive({
    river_coords[river_coords$model %in% input$model, ]
  })
  
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>% 
      addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = "Street") %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
      fitBounds(min(river_coords$longitude), min(river_coords$latitude), max(river_coords$longitude), max(river_coords$latitude)) %>%
      addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Street", "Satellite"),
                     overlayGroups = c("Climate", "Sites"),
                     options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
    
  })
  
  observe({
      leafletProxy("map") %>% 
      clearGroup("Climate") %>%
      clearControls()
      req(input$layer != "none")
      
      idx <- which.min(abs(as.numeric(tm_pr) - as.numeric(input$date)))
      req(length(idx) == 1)
      
       if (input$layer == "pr") {
    r <- pr[[idx]]; p <- pal_p; stack_vals <- values(pr); unit <- "mm/month"
  } else {
    r <- tmax[[idx]]; p <- pal_t; stack_vals <- values(tmax); unit <- "°C"
  }
      
      lyr <- disagg(r, fact = 8, method = "bilinear")

      leafletProxy("map") %>%
    addRasterImage(lyr, colors = p, opacity = 0.85,
                   group = "Climate", project = FALSE, method = "bilinear") %>%
    addLegend("bottomright", pal = p, values = stack_vals,
              title = paste0(format(tm_pr[idx], "%B %Y"), "<br>(", unit, ")"))
      
  })

  observe({
      leafletProxy("map", data = filtered()) %>%
      clearGroup("stream_name_pse") %>%
      addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude,
                   group = "stream_name_pse",
                   fillColor = ~pal(model),
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   stroke = FALSE,
                   radius = 6,
                   popup = ~paste0("<b>", stream_name_pse, "</b><br>Model: ", model))
  })
  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
